purpose: Curated manual context for the future RosterPilot AI coach. The journal does not directly alter deterministic recommendation scores.
rules: Store reported facts separately from analyst opinions and RosterPilot inferences.
Do not convert an analyst scenario or projection into a factual claim.
Preserve conflicting source opinions instead of forcing a single consensus.
Mark injuries, camp roles, ADP and unresolved legal/suspension items as time-sensitive.
Summarize source material; do not store full article text.
A future AI coach may use these entries as grounding, but deterministic RosterPilot rankings and recommendation logic remain authoritative.

facts.summary: Mike McDaniel is the Chargers' new offensive coordinator.
Keenan Allen is no longer part of the Chargers receiving room and is with Indianapolis.

outlook.summary: McConkey has a plausible path to a better receiving environment because a major target competitor left and the offense changed coordinators; the size of any production gain is uncertain.

facts.summary: Footballguys describes Keaton Mitchell as a complementary back behind Hampton.
CBS highlights improved health and the return/addition of offensive-line help around Hampton.

outlook.summary: CBS's model presents Hampton as a breakout candidate and values him above several backs being drafted earlier.

facts.summary: David Njoku joined the Chargers after leaving Cleveland.

outlook.summary: Njoku adds another established receiving option and could affect tight-end target distribution.

facts.summary: Mike LaFleur took over as Arizona head coach after serving as Rams offensive coordinator.
Kyler Murray left Arizona, with Jacoby Brissett expected to start Week 1.
Arizona drafted Jeremiyah Love third overall and added Tyler Allgeier.

outlook.summary: Arizona has major scheme, quarterback and backfield changes, so prior-year usage should not be projected forward mechanically.

facts.summary: NFL.com's rookie outlook flags a high-ankle sprain as a key near-term risk for Love.

outlook.summary: Love retains lead-back upside, but health and a crowded rotation create early-season uncertainty.

facts.summary: Kevin Stefanski became Atlanta's head coach and Tommy Rees joined as offensive coordinator.
Tua Tagovailoa was added with Michael Penix Jr. recovering from a knee injury.
Brian Robinson Jr. was added behind Bijan Robinson, and Jahan Dotson was added after Darnell Mooney left.

outlook.summary: Atlanta's core fantasy players enter a materially different offensive environment, especially at quarterback and secondary touch competition.

facts.summary: Baltimore hired Jesse Minter as head coach and Declan Doyle as offensive coordinator.
Baltimore drafted Ja'Kobi Lane and Elijah Sarratt at wide receiver.

outlook.summary: The offense has new leadership and new receiver depth, so role assumptions should be refreshed during camp.

facts.summary: NFL.com identifies Lane as a late-round sleeper after a strong start to camp and cites a path to the No. 2/red-zone receiver role.
The Seahawks fantasy roundup also lists Lane as a late value target.

outlook.summary: Multiple sources see inexpensive upside if Lane earns a meaningful secondary receiver role.

facts.summary: Buffalo acquired DJ Moore from Chicago.

outlook.summary: Moore improves Buffalo's receiving talent but changes target distribution for incumbent pass catchers.

facts.summary: Yahoo's fade column questions Cook's first-round ceiling, citing limited receiving involvement and added receiving competition.

outlook.summary: Yahoo views Cook's draft price as aggressive relative to his receiving-volume ceiling.

facts.summary: Footballguys says Rico Dowdle's departure creates room for a healthy Brooks to take on a larger workload alongside Hubbard.
The Seahawks fantasy roundup presents Brooks as a value based on recovery and preseason first-team work.
Yahoo's fade column is more cautious because of Brooks' injury history, Hubbard competition and price.

outlook.summary: Brooks has workload upside but unusually wide uncertainty; RosterPilot should surface both the positive camp signal and the injury/competition downside.

facts.summary: Chicago traded DJ Moore to Buffalo.

outlook.summary: Moore's departure removes a major target competitor from Chicago's receiver room.

facts.summary: Todd Monken became Cleveland's head coach and primary play-caller.
Cleveland added first-round WR KC Concepcion and second-round WR Denzel Boston.
Quinshon Judkins is working back from a major leg injury.

outlook.summary: Cleveland offers meaningful opportunity for young players but carries quarterback and role uncertainty.

facts.summary: FantasyPros lists Concepcion among ADP risers and sees a possible path to Cleveland's No. 1 receiver role.
NFL.com's rookie scenario emphasizes his separation ability but also quarterback uncertainty and competition.

outlook.summary: There is credible breakout opportunity, tempered by Cleveland's quarterback uncertainty and other young receiving options.

facts.summary: NFL.com highlights Boston as a late sleeper based on first-team camp work and positive reviews.
NFL.com's rookie outlook also gives Boston a path to a substantial receiving role.

outlook.summary: Boston is a late-round upside target if his camp role survives into the regular season.

facts.summary: Denver acquired Jaylen Waddle from Miami.

outlook.summary: Waddle raises the ceiling of Denver's passing game while also redistributing targets among incumbent receivers.

facts.summary: Footballguys says Dobbins enters the season healthy and Denver added rookie Jonah Coleman.
FantasyPros notes Dobbins as an ADP riser and characterizes him as the likely early-down leader.

outlook.summary: Dobbins has positive role momentum, though Coleman keeps the backfield from being a pure one-player situation.

facts.summary: Drew Petzing became Detroit's offensive coordinator.
David Montgomery left for Houston and Detroit added Isiah Pacheco as the complementary back behind Gibbs.

outlook.summary: Gibbs remains the clear lead talent while his backfield partner and offensive coordinator changed; monitor whether Pacheco inherits Montgomery's exact workload or a smaller one.

facts.summary: FantasyPros lists Reed as an ADP riser while returning from prior collarbone/foot injuries.
Green Bay lost Romeo Doubs and Dontayvion Wicks from the receiver room.

outlook.summary: Improving health plus reduced receiver competition creates a plausible path to increased opportunity.

facts.summary: Footballguys reports an open legal investigation stemming from a May arrest that could lead to a suspension.

outlook.summary: This is a contingent availability risk, not a confirmed suspension; treat it as time-sensitive until resolved.

entries.notes: Do not state that Jacobs is suspended unless a later source confirms it.

facts.summary: Houston traded for David Montgomery after not re-signing Nick Chubb.
Footballguys expects a heavy three-down role for Montgomery.
Yahoo's fade column is skeptical at price because of Houston's rushing environment and competition from Woody Marks.

outlook.summary: Montgomery has a strong role case but not universal analyst support; the journal should preserve the disagreement rather than collapse it.

facts.summary: NFL.com's sleeper article says Dell returned to full-pads practice in August after missing 2025 while recovering from a severe 2024 knee injury.

outlook.summary: NFL.com views Dell as a low-cost upside bet if his recovery continues and a meaningful receiving role returns.

facts.summary: Indianapolis re-signed Alec Pierce and traded Michael Pittman Jr. to Pittsburgh.
FantasyPros reports Keenan Allen joining Indianapolis.
The Seahawks fantasy roundup still identifies Josh Downs as a value candidate despite Allen's arrival.

outlook.summary: Indianapolis' target hierarchy changed substantially; Allen adds competition while Pittman's departure opens volume.

facts.summary: Travis Etienne left Jacksonville, with Tuten competing for the lead role and Chris Rodriguez added as a physical complement.
NFL.com lists Rodriguez as a late sleeper and notes meaningful camp/preseason opportunity.

outlook.summary: Etienne's departure creates draftable ambiguity: Tuten has lead-role upside, while Rodriguez has inexpensive touchdown/early-down upside.

facts.summary: Footballguys says Mahomes was cleared for full practice after his 2025 knee injury.
Kansas City added Kenneth Walker III after Isiah Pacheco left.
Yahoo's fade column questions Mahomes' fantasy price partly because post-injury rushing could fall and the offense could lean more on Walker.

outlook.summary: Mahomes' real-life ceiling remains elite, but Yahoo sees a fantasy-volume risk if rushing production falls and the run game expands.

facts.summary: Klint Kubiak became Las Vegas head coach/play-caller; Kirk Cousins joined and Fernando Mendoza was drafted first overall.
NFL.com's rookie outlook presents Mendoza's best-case development path as beginning behind Cousins before taking over later.

outlook.summary: The Raiders have both a veteran bridge and a high-investment rookie, creating timing risk for Mendoza in one-QB redraft leagues.

facts.summary: Malik Willis left Green Bay for Miami.
CBS's model highlights Willis as a breakout candidate with a starting opportunity and fantasy value from his rushing ability.

outlook.summary: Willis carries late-round upside if he retains the starting job because rushing can raise his weekly floor.

facts.summary: FantasyPros lists Hill as an ADP faller after his release from Miami and notes recovery from a severe 2025 knee injury.

outlook.summary: Uncertain team fit and recovery timeline make Hill a highly time-sensitive draft asset.

facts.summary: A.J. Brown moved from Philadelphia to New England.
Romeo Doubs left Green Bay for New England.
FantasyPros lists Doubs as an ADP riser and sees a likely secondary role behind Brown.

outlook.summary: Doubs has a clearer projected role in a new offense, though Brown remains the primary target competition.

facts.summary: FantasyPros flags Tyson's hamstring issue as a reason for a large ADP decline.
NFL.com's rookie outlook also makes recovery from the hamstring injury central to his range of outcomes.

outlook.summary: Tyson's draft value is currently dominated by injury-timeline uncertainty and should be refreshed close to draft day.

facts.summary: FantasyPros lists Tracy as an ADP faller, pointing to added competition and pass-protection concerns.

outlook.summary: His workload projection is less secure than earlier in the offseason.

facts.summary: Isaiah Likely left Baltimore for the Giants.
The Seahawks fantasy roundup lists Likely as a tight-end value based on potential for a larger receiving role.

outlook.summary: A new team creates a plausible path to more receiving work, but the role still needs regular-season confirmation.

facts.summary: FantasyPros lists Darnold as an ADP faller and cites a run-heavy offensive environment as a fantasy-ceiling concern.

outlook.summary: The concern is fantasy passing volume rather than necessarily poor real-life quarterback play.

facts.summary: NFL.com's rookie outlook flags a core-muscle injury and competition from Mason Taylor as key factors for Sadiq.

outlook.summary: Sadiq has rookie upside but begins with health and role uncertainty.

facts.summary: NFL.com's rookie outlook sees role upside for Lemon but notes hamstring-related missed work as a risk.

outlook.summary: Lemon's talent/role case is attractive if health allows him to secure early snaps.

facts.summary: Indianapolis traded Michael Pittman Jr. to Pittsburgh.

outlook.summary: Pittman's move changes both Pittsburgh's target competition and Indianapolis' vacated volume; more team-specific evidence is needed before assigning a stronger direction.

facts.summary: FantasyPros lists Stribling as a major ADP riser amid injuries in San Francisco's receiver room.
NFL.com's rookie outlook warns that established target competition can cap his ceiling.
The Seahawks fantasy roundup also lists Stribling as a late value after strong preseason play.

outlook.summary: Stribling has strong late-round momentum, but the target tree remains crowded enough to cap confidence.

facts.summary: NFL.com's rookie outlook gives Price a path to substantial work while Zach Charbonnet returns from ACL injury, while also flagging ball-security and pass-protection downside.

outlook.summary: Price has a meaningful early opportunity but needs to earn trust in passing situations and ball security.

facts.summary: The Seahawks fantasy roundup cites a healthy/full preseason and improving rapport with the quarterback as part of Shaheed's late-round case.

outlook.summary: Shaheed offers inexpensive big-play upside if the preseason role carries over.

facts.summary: NFL.com's rookie outlook gives Tate a path to leading Tennessee in targets if the passing offense improves.
Yahoo's fade column is less enthusiastic at current draft cost because of rookie, role and offensive-environment uncertainty.

outlook.summary: Tate has high target-share upside but enough uncertainty that price is the key variable.

facts.summary: NFL.com lists Diggs as a late-round sleeper after joining Washington and sees a plausible high-volume secondary/1B receiving role.

outlook.summary: Diggs' cost may understate his path to meaningful targets if his efficiency and health hold.

facts.summary: NFL.com lists Kincaid as a late-round sleeper and emphasizes improved health plus strong receiving-efficiency indicators.

outlook.summary: Kincaid has TE1 upside at a discounted cost if health and route involvement persist.

facts.summary: The Seahawks fantasy roundup lists Golden as a value and cites a strong offseason plus deep-threat potential.

outlook.summary: Golden is a late-round ceiling play in a receiver room that lost multiple veterans.

facts.summary: The Seahawks fantasy roundup lists Harris as a deep value and cites Mike McDaniel's arrival, likely three-receiver usage and Harris' blocking as paths to playing time.

outlook.summary: Harris has inexpensive role upside if McDaniel uses frequent three-WR personnel and Harris stays on the field.

facts.summary: The Seahawks fantasy roundup lists White as a later-round running-back value.

outlook.summary: Treat as a price-sensitive depth target; the journal needs more role evidence before making a stronger claim.

facts.summary: Allgeier joined Arizona, where rookie Jeremiyah Love is expected to lead the backfield.
The Seahawks fantasy roundup lists Allgeier as a late value.

outlook.summary: Allgeier has standalone/contingent value but faces a highly drafted rookie ahead of him.

facts.summary: The Seahawks fantasy roundup lists Mayfield as a late quarterback value if healthy.

outlook.summary: Mayfield is a wait-on-QB option rather than a reason to force quarterback early.

facts.summary: The Seahawks fantasy roundup lists Shough as a late quarterback value.

outlook.summary: He is a low-cost quarterback option whose value depends heavily on the surrounding offense and weekly streaming context.

facts.summary: Yahoo's fade column questions McBride's third-round price amid expected volume regression in Arizona's changed offense.

outlook.summary: The fade is about price and volume expectations, not a claim that McBride is a poor player.

facts.summary: Yahoo's fade column cites continued knee-recovery concerns and a changing Kansas City offensive environment as reasons for caution at cost.

outlook.summary: Rice's health/recovery timeline is a material draft-day variable and should be refreshed close to the draft.

facts.summary: Yahoo's fade column views Burrow's Round 4 cost as expensive given the depth of the quarterback position.

outlook.summary: This is a roster-construction/value objection rather than a negative talent outlook.

facts.summary: Yahoo's fade column questions Irving's price, citing 2025 rushing efficiency and competition for goal-line/passing-down work.

outlook.summary: Irving may still be useful, but Yahoo sees workload segmentation as a reason to avoid paying an aggressive price.

facts.summary: Yahoo's fade column cites Rhamondre Stevenson competition plus Henderson's pass-protection/volume concerns.

outlook.summary: The concern is that Henderson's role may not justify his draft cost without a clear workload takeover.

facts.summary: Yahoo's fade column highlights Kittle's Achilles recovery and the risk of a slow ramp-up/efficiency decline.

outlook.summary: Kittle's health status is highly time-sensitive and should be refreshed immediately before the draft.

facts.summary: Yahoo's fade column is cautious on Godwin because of age/injury history, 2025 efficiency and competition in Tampa Bay's receiving room.

outlook.summary: The downside case is a price/role/health combination rather than a certainty of poor production.
